rationale: P identifies the braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate whether required braking maneuvers are omitted. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking itself—not merely mechanisms supporting it—as the relevant system behaviour. The hazard supports the collision-avoidance context and pedestrian scenario. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” directly addresses performance or omission of the required maneuver identified by T and SG-1.
“Where a braking maneuver is required to avoid a collision” appropriately limits the phenomenon to the circumstances established by FR-7 and H-1.
The scope includes obstacles and road users, with the pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead explicitly supported by H-1.
Neither the statement nor scope incorporates supporting mechanisms or their timing constraints into P.
